{{Top|leg}}
A '''catalytic processor''' was an integral part of a [[decon droid]]. Each [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had a series of catalytic processors that cleansed irradiated and contaminated materials before releasing them once the cycle had been completed.<ref name="DFRS">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>
